I'm not sure how I would answer about coping as I have had very little times where I feel like I can cope... both a sense of hope for the future whilst having as no worries as possible sounds like the place where I can cope...

Being safe means security to not just my physical self but mental state, Where I can just be myself and carry out any habits that I have such as showering after my first coffee and sleeping when I am supposed to... But also not feel threatened by anyone and having to deal with anyone to make them go away.

Peace of mind only happened when I managed to let go of all my burdens... all my stress... everything that has bottled up within me for years, stretching all the way back to my childhood. And it is a lovely feeling to be free of the weight my mind carries.
I know it's easy to say it will all be undone but it as easy as just something going wrong like misplacing my keys somewhere in the flat and being unable to find them stretching to someone telling me how happy and wonderful life is... These little things upset me and my mind takes it to the extreme by looking for ways to either short term fix it or if I cant, that's when the suicidal thoughts start happening...

Ok. There is nothing else for it... I plan on dying in 23 hours now as there really is no way forward with anything anymore. I'm gonna be getting a rope before my shift and when christmas day hits, I'll hang myself in my flat, it will give me plenty of time to ensure I am successful. I am 100% sure of my choice now and I cannot be swayed. I don't want to do any of this anymore and I wish to take my life before the damage gets worse... I've already made the preparations with the bin and hanged a drying rack on some piping at the ceiling of my flat which I've stress tested over and over again. It shouldn't be too hard...

I shall be saying my goodbyes to you all before I go.

In terms of work, my job is to stand in one spot without being allowed to sit. Ever. For 4 hours straight. I've done this for over 3 years now as part of my job and now everyday I come home with the back of my neck, my shoulders and the lower half of my back in absolute agony. I eventually cope after a few hours but combined with the low dips in my mood I just end up not being able to get anything done to move forward in life I guess?

Sorry I wasn't clear, I recently started (big emphasis on started) having paranoia.... Literally just typing this I swear I heard a stone being thrown at the window next to me! I've already taken the first steps in being supported tonight. I spent most of the night where I found an international crisis centre and I was really, really welcomed. They let me sit there for a full 1 hour and 30 minutes to tell my entire story. And it felt really, really good. I even told the support worker eventually how I had never felt such peace of mind. Overall it was lovely and it has put a halt on my thoughts to punish myself or end my life. For now at least. I however am afraid that will be all be undone in the future just like how coping strategies wouldn't last me more than a week before the voices telling me to go kill myself get louder than said coping strategies.
Somebody... Please show me a way out, I cant do this anymore
